clips.title: The U.A.E.’s AI Ambitions
clips.quote: So some of our most successful exits so far are artificial intelligence stories of success. Careem is an artificial intelligence company that got acquired for 11 billion dirhams, 3.1 or 3.2 billion dollars. Souq.com got acquired by Amazon for more than 2 billion dirhams, and Media.net got acquired for more than 3 billion dirhams. These are all artificial intelligence companies in their core, and these are probably their proof that our leadership has been working on this for years.
clips.speaker: H.E. Omar Bin Sultan Al Olama

clips.title: نشرة الرابعة |  ولي العهد السعودي يرعى القمة العالمية للذكاء الاصطناعي
clips.quote: وهذا هو دورنا في سدايا وهذا هو دورنا في القمة لتبيين الحقائق لرسم المستقبل الجديد للذكاء الاصطناعي الذي سيكون بإذن الله خيرا للبشرية
clips.speaker: ماجد الشهري

clips.title: نشرة الرابعة: الغامدي: السعودية تسعى إلى أن تكون ملتقى للعالم في احتضان الذكاء الاصطناعي
clips.quote: نسعى لأن نصبح ملتقى رئيسا للعالم للشرق والغرب نحتضن الذكاء الاصطناعي ونسخر قدراته معا ونطلق إمكاناته لخير الإنسانية جمعاء.
clips.speaker: عبد الله الغامدي

clips.title: The U.A.E.’s AI Ambitions
clips.quote: Definitely, and it also proves that there is something to be got out of it. We're not doing AI for the sake of AI, we're doing AI because it's something that creates value, and there are returns that make it tangible and feasible as well to do.
clips.speaker: H.E. Omar Bin Sultan Al Olama

clips.title: UAE AI Minister: Country is against “regulating tech for the sake of regulating” | CNBC Conversation
clips.quote: So we are playing a big role in trying to start the discussions on where we should regulate artificial intelligence. I'm not for overregulation and the UAE is not for regulating a technology for the sake of regulating it. But we are for proactive regulations of certain uses of the technology.
clips.speaker: Omar Al Olama

clips.title: UAE AI Minister: Country is against “regulating tech for the sake of regulating” | CNBC Conversation
clips.quote: So AI should not be used to automate weapons that will kill people on a mass scale. Is there a dialogue that's being had? Maybe. But the UAE is playing a big role in trying to really start these discussions and see where they can lead.
clips.speaker: Omar Al Olama

clips.title: Aramco CEO Amin Nasser on the Future of Oil, AI & Saudi Vision 2030 (Extended Interview)
clips.quote: There is significant growth, as I'm sure you've seen through the tours, in technology and digitalization, in AI, to maintain our low-cost structure, extraction cost and development cost, and at the same time reduce our carbon footprint.
clips.speaker: Amin Nasser

clips.title: Aramco CEO Amin Nasser on the Future of Oil, AI & Saudi Vision 2030 (Extended Interview)
clips.quote: Technology realization in 2023 used to be $2 billion. This is how much we realized from technology. In '24, $4 billion. And we're looking at $2 to $4 billion per year in technology. So we are benefiting out from these technology application. AI is in everything embedded, not only in terms of allowing us to reduce our cost structure, more efficiency, it also helps us in reducing our carbon footprint.
clips.speaker: Amin Nasser

clips.title: Aramco CEO Amin Nasser on the Future of Oil, AI & Saudi Vision 2030 (Extended Interview)
clips.quote: If you look at our talents, how many people trained on AI in Aramco? We have the AI specialist, a couple of hundreds, but the AI-enabled, trained AI professional around more than 6,000, and we're training more and more every year.
clips.speaker: Amin Nasser

clips.title: Inside the Gulf’s trillion-dollar AI gamble
clips.quote: With energy and cash to spare, Gulf monarchies are positioning their countries and their capital to take a lead in the AI race, both acquiring and building the latest technology. I took a deep dive into the sovereign strategies of Abu Dhabi, Riyadh, and Doha and looked at how each major player is investing across artificial intelligence to gain a foothold in this space.
clips.speaker: Emma Graham

clips.title: Inside the Gulf’s trillion-dollar AI gamble
clips.quote: And Riyadh has its own AI champion, Humain, backed by its nearly $1 trillion Sovereign Wealth Fund, the PIF. They want to make Saudi Arabia the biggest AI power after the likes, of course, of the US and China.
clips.speaker: Emma Graham

clips.title: Inside the Gulf’s trillion-dollar AI gamble
clips.quote: Plus Qatar, who's over $500 billion Sovereign Wealth Fund, the QIA, told CNBC their strategy is investing across the value stack of AI, rather than backing a single local AI company like the UAE's G42 or Saudi's Humain.
clips.speaker: Emma Graham

clips.title: Inside the Gulf’s trillion-dollar AI gamble
clips.quote: From Abu Dhabi's G42 and MGX, and their massive US-UAE AI campus, to the lifting of export controls for Nvidia chips announced this week by Microsoft. The UAE was talking about AI before it was cool, according to Sam Altman.
clips.speaker: Emma Graham

clips.title: The U.A.E.’s AI Ambitions
clips.quote: The United Arab Emirates is a country that prides itself on building big and being first and that extends to the tech sector with the UAE's appointment of the world's first minister for artificial intelligence. Behind the ministry's creation is the Emirates' lofty ambition to be the global leader in AI and for that commitment to boost the UAE's GDP by 35% by 2031.
clips.speaker: Journaliste

clips.title: Saudi Arabia Plans $100 Billion AI Project to Rival UAE Technology Hub
clips.quote: Well, both Saudi Arabia and the UAE have been racing to set up data centers and kind of position themselves as the dominant force in AI in the region. And honestly, so far it had looked like Abu Dhabi was pulling ahead. Abu Dhabi has its G42 fund, which is a massive fund that has secured huge commitments from Microsoft and also we saw a deal struck back in September with Nvidia.
clips.speaker: CHRISTINE BURKE

clips.title: Saudi Arabia Plans $100 Billion AI Project to Rival UAE Technology Hub
clips.quote: And then last week out of FII, we also saw the PIF, that's Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund, it announced a partnership with Google Cloud to develop a new AI hub in the Eastern Province of Dammam. Sources told us that that initiative or that new AI hub could see investments of as much as 10 billion dollars.
clips.speaker: CHRISTINE BURKE

clips.title: نشرة الرابعة |  ولي العهد السعودي يرعى القمة العالمية للذكاء الاصطناعي
clips.quote: تحتضن الرياض غدا وبعد غد أول قمة عالمية للذكاء الاصطناعي برعاية ولي العهد السعودي الأمير محمد بن سلمان تحت شعار الذكاء الاصطناعي لخير البشرية والتي تشرف عليها هيئة البيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي السعودية سدايا
clips.speaker: Journaliste

clips.title: نشرة الرابعة: الغامدي: السعودية تسعى إلى أن تكون ملتقى للعالم في احتضان الذكاء الاصطناعي
clips.quote: فعاليات القمة العالمية للذكاء الاصطناعي الأولى عالميا انطلقت بمشاركة مئات الخبراء والمسؤولين والمستثمرين في المجال التقني من حول العالم وبإشراف الهيئة السعودية للبيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي سدايا
clips.speaker: مذيع العربية

clips.title: نشرة الرابعة: الغامدي: السعودية تسعى إلى أن تكون ملتقى للعالم في احتضان الذكاء الاصطناعي
clips.quote: وفي افتتاح القمة، قال رئيس الهيئة السعودية للبيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي عبد الله الغامدي، قال إن السعودية تسعى لأن تكون ملتقى رئيسيا للعالم للشرق والغرب لاحتضان الذكاء الاصطناعي وتسخير قدراته لخدمة الإنسانية جمعاء.
clips.speaker: مذيع العربية

clips.title: Saudi Arabia Plans $100 Billion AI Project to Rival UAE Technology Hub
clips.quote: So sources are telling us that Saudi Arabia is planning a project known as Project Transcendence. We are told that this is going to be a fund that will invest in AI infrastructure, AI startups, and also companies that are willing to commit their resources to the kingdom in order to help the country scale up in its AI ambitions.
clips.speaker: CHRISTINE BURKE
